name: io.github.beepboop2025/seiche
title: Seiche: World-markets evidence terminal
description: Money, FX, capital-market and metadata-only China macro evidence with source clocks and limits.

tools.name: source_rights_status
tools.description: List the research tools available in this release, the one legacy reading shown research only (Funding Pop, in the funding metrics tool), and the legacy features withheld pending source qualification. Returns policy and source-rights metadata only; does not grant redistribution rights or certify freshness.

tools.name: gift_city_context
tools.description: Read dated USD/INR funding, separate ECB and CBUAE VAT FX references, and CFTC COMEX gold positioning. Cache-only research with source clocks; no executable prices or regulatory eligibility determination.

tools.name: gold_inventory_carry
tools.description: Calculate fine gold, simple financing cost and INR per fine gram from explicit decimal-string assumptions. All inputs are caller supplied, no quote is verified, and inputs are not persisted.

tools.name: market_workbench
tools.description: Query dated observations for a selected currency pair and optional accepted China annual series. Choose this for a time series, same-date FX cross, or observed-interval change; the cross-market summary gives a chartless overview and the funding metrics tool gives funding-desk metrics. Read cached official FX reference histories and same-date currency crosses, with native units, provenance, age and observed-interval changes. Inspect owner-accepted Palimpsest China annual economic series and revision-aware history beside the CNY reference. Daily fixings, annual context and licensed gaps remain distinct. No collection, model fitting, executable quotes or scoring.

provider.description: Official FX reference source. Both currencies must be supported by this provider; the response lists its currencies.

base.description: Base currency: each returned value is quote-currency units per one base unit. Must differ from quote.

quote.description: Quote currency for the selected pair's dated history; must be supported by provider and differ from base.

days.description: Calendar-day FX lookback from today, not an observation count. Only cached observations on shared dates are returned; gaps are not filled.

china_series.description: Optional exact cn.wdi.* identifier from the response's china.series catalog. Omit to select the first accepted series, if available; never invent an ID or infer withheld values.

tools.name: research_network
tools.description: Discover which published datasets and sibling-product tools can answer a research question. Choose this for catalog discovery and handoff links, not for market observations, which the cross-market summary and the FX and China history workbench serve. Explore the Palimpsest dataset catalog by topic, with source clocks, rights, freshness and pagination. Includes Seiche's separately completed funding context and explicit research steps into institution filings, exit liquidity and NarcoScope's granular global data. Source metadata and funding interpretations stay distinct. May fetch the published catalog; does not retrieve underlying dataset values or call the suggested sibling tools. No source collection, score changes, causal joins or trading authority.

topic.description: Research topic used to filter dataset metadata and select suggested sibling-product tools. This does not query those tools or retrieve dataset values.

offset.description: Zero-based offset within the filtered catalog. Use the returned next_offset while keeping topic and limit unchanged.

limit.description: Maximum dataset metadata entries per page; suggested research steps are separate from this page size.

tools.name: money_market_context
tools.description: Inspect a funding desk's rates, spreads, policy corridor, liquidity buffers and source-level evidence for USD, India and supported countries. Choose this for detailed funding metrics; a cross-asset overview and FX or accepted China time series have their own tools. Start with section='summary' for USD; it also returns funding_pop, a separate research-only block with its skill, as the website shows it. Other sections cover USD desk detail, diagnostics, official rates, countries and India; the section parameter describes each. Returns exact-date alignment, native-cadence changes, empirical own-history statistics, freshness, coverage, formulas, sources, and caveats as applicable. Chart history is always omitted. USD reads only an already completed cached or persisted snapshot; it never triggers collection or engine recomputation, while freshness is re-evaluated at response time. Context only: no causal, predictive, probability, or trade claim.

section.description: Projection to return; defaults to the compact USD desk summary, which also carries the research-only funding_pop block. Granular, descriptive USD sections from the already assembled desk: policy_corridor (policy corridor and overnight spreads), secured_distributions (SOFR/TGCR/BGCR distributions and tails), repo_segments (repo-segment rates and volumes), unsecured_funding (CP-Treasury spreads), bills_cash_curve (bills and cash curve), liquidity_buffers (liquidity buffers and Fed facilities) and mmf_plumbing (MMF repo plumbing). diagnostics counts funding persistence, compares secured/unsecured benchmarks and shows calendar cohorts with sample limits, without changing any score. rates_catalog, funding_conditions, curve, spread and rate_series form the official rates research desk: stored series with source clocks; overnight benchmarks against policy anchor and corridor across currencies; government curves with slopes and exact forwards where the convention allows; spread percentiles in their own history with the window stated. countries is the public-source country catalog. india_states covers RBI's weekly state government securities (SDL) auctions by state (latest auction, 52-week issuance, cut-offs and bid cover). india is the India funding, RBI liquidity, policy and sovereign-curve desk from a bounded canonical observation read; it keeps benchmark identities, date alignment, curve movements and mechanism hypotheses separate. sources, methodology and all add provenance, formulas and caveats.

country.description: Country code for section=countries only: a supported ISO alpha-2 code such as JP for dated policy, funding, liquidity and sovereign references. Omit to list supported countries; UK aliases GB. Country coverage is partial and monthly references are explicitly separate from daily curves.

view.description: India only: legacy full desk, compact findings/catalog, or one exact metric card. full stays the default for compatibility; prefer summary for findings, constraints and an exact metric ID catalog, then metric with metric_id for one complete evidence card. These views are independent reads, not a pinned snapshot or pagination.

metric_id.description: Exact ID from the India summary metric_catalog; required only for view=metric.

markets.description: funding_conditions only: comma list of market ids, for example US-USD,EA-EUR.

window_days.description: funding_conditions and spread only: own-history window in days for percentiles.

curve.description: curve only: curve id, for example EA_AAA_SPOT. Omit to list curves.

date.description: curve only: ISO date; the latest curve date on or before it is used.

compare.description: curve only: comparison ISO date, same rule as date.

spread.description: spread only: spread id, for example EA_AAA_2S10S. Omit to list spreads.

instrument.description: rate_series only: instrument id from section=rates_catalog.

tools.name: world_markets_context
tools.description: Summarize available money-market, FX, macro-capital and China evidence when a question spans markets or its scope is unclear, starting with section='summary'. A chartless overview, not a time-series query; funding metrics, dated FX or China observations and dataset discovery have their own tools. Responses carry snapshot/as-of clocks, canonical citation URLs and explicit observed, derived, structural, restricted and unavailable boundaries. The China structural catalog is unsigned; only status=restricted represents a verified Seiche owner-attested revision; both states keep NBS values, raw evidence, and history withheld. Coverage is curated and partial, not exhaustive or uniformly live. It never triggers collection, repository history reads or model fitting; omitting chart and history arrays is data minimization, not a per-record licensing audit. Executable depth, liquidity-provider concentration, and position-sized exit costs are outside this tool's scope.

section.description: Projection to return; defaults to the compact cross-market summary. Sections project only completed/public state into money_markets, forex, capital_markets (macro-capital transmission), china_macro (China macro evidence), sources (official references), methodology or all. Capital coverage is limited to public positioning proxies, Treasury primary-market absorption, market stress, official liquidity and global dollar credit, not a security master, issuer-data service or consolidated tape. The sources selector is reference-only; use all when verified China context and its NBS source linkage must appear together. A separately operator-accepted economic_context may publish licensed World Bank WDI values with annual/structural freshness, distinct release, Palimpsest collection, and Seiche acceptance clocks; those values are context only and never a live print, score, gauge, forecast, or signal.

tools.name: data_health
tools.description: Freshness, provenance, and fault status for every underlying series (FRED, NY Fed, OFR, Treasury). Call this to confirm the board is current before relying on a reading.
